credits.role: the game's author (the title screen; the disk's WOZ metadata)

tools.emulator: Apple2TS 3.7.0 (git c900979), bundled by the kit into its server (kit/apple2), as an Apple II Plus (--model iiplus); check-emulator 49 passed, 0 failed, on 20 October 2026

tools.host: Linux 6.18 x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04, a hosted cloud session with no display
